reader_note: The value covers the board-composition core of Marriott's 2025 proxy: the 13-nominee slate, the independence findings (10 independent; Capuano, Harrison and David Marriott not), all six committee rosters with chairs (the Executive Committee as one sentence), the Audit and HR&C report signatures, the Chairman and Lead Independent Director, committee-independence and audit-committee-financial-expert findings, and Tresvant's February 2025 arrival and Hippeau's May 2024 retirement; every selected block states a fact. Nearly every pool fact restates the value (nominee summary table and legend, the 13 director cards, the leadership table, incidental Chairman and 13-nominee mentions); only the explicit separation of the Chairman and CEO roles (527, 528) and the 12 directors nominated in 2024 (1264) appear nowhere in it. The packet drops the summary table's cell positions, so its MEMBER/CHAIR cells were assigned to committees by the header order AC, HRCC, NCGC, ISIC, TISOC, EC, which matches every card and committee page; the bare Item 1 nominee name list (483-495) and card tenure fields were not counted as facts.
